en: A vintage monochrome (blue-tinted) postcard showing a large brick school building in winter, with bare trees and snow on the ground. The school has several stories, many windows, and a small tower-like structure on one corner. In the background are tall church spires. There are purple postal cancellation stamps on the right side and a red handwritten number "75:" near the bottom. Printed captions beneath the image identify the location and building.
